description: Update your trial tenant's persona and widget settings (name, goal, branding, position, lead notification email). Only the fields you pass are changed. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

chatbot_avatar_url.description: URL of a custom avatar image for the widget.

conversion_goal.description: What Clara should drive (e.g. "book a demo", "capture a lead").

display_name.description: Business/display name shown in the widget chrome.

language.description: "auto" detects from the visitor's browser, or pin a fixed language.

lead_destination.description: Email address captured leads are sent to.

outbound_webhook.description: Optional webhook URL for lead notifications (Zapier/Make/etc.).

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

site_url.description: The site Clara is installed on.

voice_id.description: Voice for spoken replies (a Pro feature; every trial is Pro).

name: update_tenant_settings
title: Update Tenant Settings
